terms.gloss: green beans, eaten pod and all
terms.comment: Columella’s phaseolus, the diminutive of phasēlus (see bean), with viridis, green: the unripe pods, which Pliny says are eaten with the beans inside (NH 18.125, as Morgan–Owens cites it). Apicius spells it faseolus.

phrases.latin: Faseolī viridēs et cicer ex sale, cumīnō, oleō et merō modicō īnferuntur.
phrases.english: Green beans and chickpeas are served with salt, cumin, oil and a little neat wine.

sources: Lewis & Short: phaseolus · Lewis & Short: phaselus · Lewis & Short: viridis
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. legume: beans, common: green beans.
